structure: Single high-school course document (Geography and History of the World, 2023 format). Pages 2-3: context/purpose, acknowledgments (backup); the sentence about examples is split across pages 2-3 (u11, u14). Page 4 onward: one table; row 1 = Learning Outcome for the course; then 12 topic heading rows (Cultural Hearths, World Religions, ... Global Change); each standard is a row with C1 = code (GHW.t.n) and C2 = standard text with an inline '● Examples: ...' list; '(E)' marks essential standards. Standard text and its examples sit in the same unit, so they are labeled standards; a few cells continue across page breaks as separate units.
